groups.basis: Both facts record the same offer from beat_10. Lady Hilda, a seasoned armoured fighter who cannot hunt the dragon alone, would join the party's dragon hunt for money. Both have the same trigger (hiring her for pay) and the same benefit (her combat help against the dragon), and both help thread_3. They share the established certainty and the opening form.
groups.text: If the party pays Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter in chain mail and shield who says she can't hunt the dragon alone, she will join their dragon hunt, though her fee is not yet set.
